overview: The Pylon Galleries house the Luclinite arcane pylons that stabilize the Basilica’s void resonance and geometric structure.
history: Luclinite architects constructed the galleries to channel resonance safely.
Crystalline conduits were installed to distribute energy across the Basilica.
Custodian constructs were created to maintain pylon alignment.
Akhevan forces discovered the galleries and attempted to disrupt the network.
A resonance cascade partially destabilized several pylons.
hooks: A pylon begins to overload dangerously.
Custodian constructs malfunction after a resonance spike.
Akhevan intruders attempt to sever a conduit.
A crystalline conduit fractures, releasing unstable energy.
